clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, Cactus Apples offer orcs a rare source of moisture in Durotar's dry heat.

Cactus apples grow in clusters around the thick cactuses scattered across the Valley of Trials. Gathering them means working among the thorns, but the fruit gives welcome hydration in Durotar's heat. Galgar, an orc in the valley, gathers the apples to make Cactus Apple Surprise, a cooling treat for recruits enduring their early training.
